        "C",
        "I"
      ],
      "Attack": "An attacker could read or alter host or backing-bus data so that a cached word is disclosed or a later cache hit returns an incorrect value.",

      "Concept Name": "Cache access address",
      "Unit": "neorv32_cache",

      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",

    {
      "Candidate Name": "Uncached relayed data",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",

    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Cache tag and valid metadata",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The tag and valid bits only record which backing-memory words are cached, so the cached-copies rule bars them as pieces of their own; their combined decision is represented by the cache hit or miss asset."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Cache bypass route bit",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "ctrl.buf_dir is a one-bit route bit set from access fields and read only to route the access, so the bus-handshake bookkeeping rule bars it as information of its own."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Controller sequencing state and transfer counter",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "ctrl.state and ctrl.ofs only sequence and pace lookup, refill, acknowledgement, and word transfers, so the sequencing-state rule bars them as separate information."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Captured address fragments",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "C2",
      "Why Not Kept": ""
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Bus access command and handshake fields",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "The strobe, read/write direction, byte enables, acknowledge, and related fields are access-command or bus-handshake information, not separate pieces of their own under the access-command and handshake-copy rules."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Cache build-time configuration",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "NUM_BLOCKS, BLOCK_SIZE, UC_BEGIN, and READ_ONLY only fix build-time structure or policy and cannot be changed or withheld by an element at run time."
    },
    {
      "Candidate Name": "Clock and reset behavior",
      "Candidate Unit": "neorv32_cache",
      "Merged Into": "",
      "Why Not Kept": "clk_i and rstn_i and their reset or timing effects are excluded by the clock and reset rule rather than treated as conceptual information assets."
    }
  ],
  "Notes": []
}
